mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ATCH_FILE ( FILE_ID, ATCH_FILE_GRPID, ORGNL_FILE_NM, PHYS_FILE_NM, FILE_PATH, FILE_SZ, FILE_EXT, REG_DT, RGTR_ID ) VALUES ( #{fileId}, #{atchFileGrpid}, #{orgnlFileNm}, #{physFileNm}, #{filePath}, #{fileSz}, #{fileExt}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, #{userId} )
mapper.select: SELECT FILE_ID, ATCH_FILE_GRPID, ORGNL_FILE_NM, PHYS_FILE_NM, FILE_PATH, FILE_SZ, FILE_EXT, REG_DT, RGTR_ID FROM ATCH_FILE WHERE FILE_ID = #{fileId}
SELECT FILE_ID, ATCH_FILE_GRPID, ORGNL_FILE_NM, PHYS_FILE_NM, FILE_PATH, FILE_SZ, FILE_EXT, REG_DT, RGTR_ID FROM ATCH_FILE WHERE ATCH_FILE_GRPID = #{atchFileGrpid} ORDER BY REG_DT ASC

SELECT FILE_ID, ATCH_FILE_GRPID, ORGNL_FILE_NM, PHYS_FILE_NM, FILE_PATH, FILE_SZ, FILE_EXT, REG_DT, RGTR_ID FROM ATCH_FILE WHERE 1 = 1
AND (ATCH_FILE_GRPID LIKE 'MP_%' OR (ATCH_FILE_GRPID NOT LIKE 'TUS_%' AND ATCH_FILE_GRPID NOT LIKE 'DROPZONE_%'))
AND ATCH_FILE_GRPID LIKE 'TUS_%'
AND ATCH_FILE_GRPID LIKE 'DROPZONE_%'
ORDER BY REG_DT DESC
